description: Test routines for checking protocol disabling in Git, including functions for testing environment variable and config-based protocol allowances, and setup functions for SSH and remote wrappers.

methods.name: test_allow_var
methods.description: Tests clone, fetch, push with GIT_ALLOW_PROTOCOL environment variable.

methods.name: test_config
methods.description: Tests clone, fetch, push with protocol.<type>.allow config and related environment variables.

methods.name: test_proto
methods.description: Runs both allow_var and config tests for a specific protocol.

methods.name: setup_ssh_wrapper
methods.description: Sets up an SSH wrapper script for testing SSH access.

methods.name: setup_ext_wrapper
methods.description: Sets up a wrapper for remote-ext access to repositories.
